reasoning.text: Reproducibility: the arithmetic core is fully pinned — both impls independently converge on identical, correct, self-verifying negacyclic NTT/INTT/Barrett behavior — but the spec leaves the decimation convention, twiddle-ROM/stage schedule, radix-4 fusion mapping, and (critically) a WORKING conflict-free bank map open, so the divergent choices show the system's hardware structure is not rebuildable as-is. Fidelity: every recoverable numeric parameter (q, psi=1945, omega=10302, N^-1=12277, Barrett mu=21843/k=28) matches the reference exactly, but the paper's signature contributions — the conflict-free memory mapping, the no-bit-reversal dataflow, and the 33%/20%/50% resource savings — are unverifiable or violated in both reproductions, which are generically correct NTT engines rather than the specific CFNTT architecture.
gaps: [operation] The paper's actual conflict-free bank-index and offset functions (CFNTT Sec. III map); the spec's candidate provably collides for strides 2^6..2^9
[operation] Per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s and the radix-4 4-operand routing
[operation] Twiddle-ROM address function f(stage s, block) and the low/high-half negacyclic-storage layout
[operation] DIT vs DIF decimation choice and whether a bit-reversal stage exists (reference claims none)
[control] Global butterfly/stage ordering schedule (the rearranged loop structure enabling twiddle reuse)
[control] Which two radix-2 stages each radix-4 BU fuses, and the stride-switching the radix selector applies
[param] Authoritative transform flavor (negacyclic vs cyclic) — spec only infers from PQC/HE context
[timing] Per-stage cycle counts so the 9-cycle/lane pipeline timing model is faithful (currently 'reproduction defaults')
[param] Generator/primitive-root choice that yields psi (g=11→psi=1945 is reproduction-chosen)
